kitDescription: Quiry is a Wind rocket-launcher Supporter whose kit is aimed almost entirely at Defender-class teammates. Each full-charge shot she fires grants up to two Defender allies bonus attack equal to 5.81% of her own attack for 3 seconds, and the same hits reduce the struck target's attack by 8.94% of hers for 3 seconds. At the start of battle she permanently raises two Defender allies' max HP by 11.63%. Her Burst II heals the whole team for 6.96% of her max HP once per second for 10 seconds, and gives all Defender allies +19.9% critical rate for 10 seconds. She has no personal damage lines; her value is Defender-scoped attack and crit support plus team sustain.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA exists in the driver implementation: all five kit lines are FAITHFUL (S1 ally ATK grant, S2 Max HP grant, burst heal window, burst crit grant) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (S1 enemy ATK▼, correctly unmodeled verbatim with the no-enemy-ATK engine reason, plus the heal magnitude and the count-2 cap carried as documented ⚑s). The two blind re-derivations converged: S6's override is byte-identical to the driver's on every line except the S1 trigger spelling (shotFired vs chargeCounter:1), which is observationally identical on an RL at scope and which the blind itself flagged as a proxy; S5's reds are entirely blind-side artifacts — one onEvent wiring bug, two null-vs-undefined type misreads, and a five-assertion burst group that went red only because the blind's own controlComp fixture hands every stage-II slot to crown and casts quiry zero times (the blind's own non-vacuity guard catches exactly this), while the driver's sole-B2 fixture pins the same burst lines green with discrimination. Every load-bearing test discriminates against its named nearest-wrong (generic atkPct all-allies, passive/permanent S1, one-shot heal, unscoped crit, casterMaxHpPct basis). Same-model residual the owner should spot-check: (1) a data-level conflict the packet does not resolve — burstCooldownSec 60 vs skillCooldownsSec.burst 40; driver and both blinds all read 60, so convergence proves stability, not correctness, and a true 40s CD would add casts/crit uptime (worth one owner glance at which column the engine and the game actually use); (2) the chargeCounter:1 full-charge identity and the 141f-reload lapse both rest on the datamined cadence tuple, which the driver itself carries as the mandatory low-tier ⚑ with a frame-count recipe; (3) the count-2 Defender cap is a real schema gap (alliesOfClass has no count field), exact on every ≤2-Defender comp and over-granting only in 3-tank teams — recorded, low severity. Nothing here blocks shipment.
